newsitem.title: USA: IES Util sees 212 MW Iowa plant up late Oct.
newsitem.headline: IES Util sees 212 MW Iowa plant up late Oct.

text.p: IES Utilities Inc expected its 212 megawatt generating station in Burlington, Iowa, to resume operation in late October after being shut last Friday for maintenance, the company said Wednesday.
"They expected to be off at a maximum of two weeks," company spokeswoman Diane Ramsey, adding technicians were preparing the coal-fired facility for the winter season.
The Burlington, Iowa, station is wholly-owned and operated by IES Utilities.
IES Utilities is based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.
